scope: LOCAL rejected standalone ANN prototype. No integration, no official score, no benchmark rerun during archival.
decision_reasons: Gaussian 10k x 128D preparation cost was approximately 9.4 seconds with 135.8-138.7 million distance evaluations.
Unfiltered Gaussian ef=256 query latency was approximately 0.49-0.54 ms; ef=512 approximately 0.73-0.77 ms in the primary run, without SQL/storage/DB reranking overhead.
The main agent selected the existing optimized exact path after its roughly 1 ms/query Docker end-to-end measurements; native exact was reported faster. No end-to-end ANN win was established.
ANN adds about 2 MiB retained graph heap plus query/build scratch to the already borrowed vector cache.
Harness UBSan alignment diagnostic makes the sanitizer-clean claim invalid and limits confidence in microbenchmark measurements.

updated_full_run_source_reconstruction.initial_run_differences: Initial run preceded optional distance callback, default ef change, initial top-level initialization fix and strengthened edge/recall assertions. Exact initial hashes not captured.

methodology.duplicate_pattern: Groups of 4 equal vectors (75% duplicate rows), plus 513 all-equal rows in edge checks.
methodology.data_and_query_generation: std::mt19937_64(seed), std::normal_distribution<float>; independent held-out query vectors. Clustered uses 32 Gaussian centers scaled by 4, per-vector random cluster and unit Gaussian noise. Same seed initializes graph random levels.
methodology.allowed_generation: One independently shuffled row permutation per dataset, nested prefixes for 25% and 1%; unfiltered uses empty allowed span.
methodology.recall_definition: Tie-aware recall@k; accepts result with exact squared L2 <= exact kth distance + abs(cutoff)*1e-12. Logged values are rounded to 4 decimals. Per-query individual results were not logged.
methodology.query_timing_scope: One sequential query call per held-out query, no warmup repetitions; includes validation, mask counting, scratch allocation, traversal and returned row vector; excludes caller DB reranking and SQL/storage.
methodology.build_timing_scope: Graph allocation/finite validation, every insertion, graph search and pairwise neighbor selection/pruning; excludes input generation.
methodology.distance_count_scope: Includes repeated upper-level and base distances; build includes neighbor-to-neighbor pruning distances. Query excludes final DB reranking.
methodology.memory_measurement: Harness global new/delete tracks requested live bytes plus its own allocation headers. Retained graph uses vector capacities; excludes borrowed input. Not RSS, system allocator footprint, or allocator fragmentation. Custom allocator has the recorded alignment UB.
methodology.filtered_exact_oracle_timing: Times allowed-only scalar double distances, vector growth and partial_sort; distinct from the optimized production DB exact kernel and not a controlled DB comparator.

existing_exact_reference.platform: Linux x86_64 emulated on Apple arm64 Docker Desktop
existing_exact_reference.comparison_limit: Docker x86_64 emulation end-to-end exact and native arm64 standalone ANN differ in platform and timing scope. Do not derive an apples-to-apples ANN-vs-exact speedup from these numbers.
